Windows Setup now gets app updates from GitHub.

- Checks when you open the helper and downloads new stable releases automatically.
- Click **Restart to update** when ready. Spotify keeps playing.
- Closing the helper does not install an update. The sign-in repair still checks once and exits without checking for app updates.
- Mac and Windows portable downloads still update manually.

**Upgrading from 1.0.3 or earlier? Install this version once to enable future Windows updates.**

Downloads:

- **Classic-Lyrics-Setup-1.0.4.exe** — Windows 10/11 x64, includes automatic app updates.
- **Classic-Lyrics-Portable-1.0.4.exe** — Windows x64, no installation.
- **Classic-Lyrics-1.0.4-macOS-Universal.dmg** — macOS 13+, Intel and Apple silicon. Drag the app to Applications.

Windows builds are unsigned. The Mac app is ad-hoc signed and not notarized. SHA-256 checksums are included; Windows updates also verify SHA-512 download integrity. The complete release is uploaded before it becomes available to the updater.

The lyrics fix, Undo, themes and permission-based private reports remain available. The visible lyrics layout has been verified on Windows, not on a live Mac Spotify installation. Spotify must continue to support the underlying layout preference.
